ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The main structure in the figure is an acyl azide-like structure. On the left, R is connected to the carbonyl carbon; the carbonyl carbon is double-bonded to the upper O, and the right side of the carbonyl carbon is single-bonded to an N; this N then forms a double bond with the middle N, and the middle N is marked with a positive charge; the middle N forms a double bond with the rightmost N, and the rightmost N is marked with a negative charge. The curved arrows in the figure are ignored according to the problem statement. Reasoning: Represent the R group with the wildcard `*`; write the carbonyl fragment as `*C(=O)`; continue connecting the single-bonded nitrogen as `*C(=O)N`; then write the two cumulated N=N double bonds and formal charges in the figure as `N=[N+]=[N-]`. Therefore the complete SMILES is `*C(=O)N=[N+]=[N-]`.
